requirements.quote: Messages sent over TCP connections use server port 53 (decimal).
requirements.condition: When sending DNS messages over TCP.
requirements.why_checkable: The server listening port and client destination port can be inspected or observed.

requirements.quote:
Messages sent over TCP connections use server port 53 (decimal).  The
message is prefixed with a two byte length field
requirements.condition: When encoding a DNS message sent over TCP.
requirements.required_behavior: Prefix the message with a length field.
requirements.why_checkable: The framing encoder and transmitted bytes expose whether a length field precedes the message.

requirements.quote:
Messages sent over TCP connections use server port 53 (decimal).  The
message is prefixed with a two byte length field
requirements.condition: For the length field prefixed to a DNS message sent over TCP.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the length field in two bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The prefix width can be checked in the encoder and on the TCP stream.

requirements.quote:
Messages sent over TCP connections use server port 53 (decimal).  The
message is prefixed with a two byte length field which gives the message

length, excluding the two byte length field.
requirements.condition: For the length field prefixed to a DNS message sent over TCP.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the length field to the message length excluding the two-byte length field itself.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded length can be compared with the framed message byte count after its prefix.

requirements.quote:
- The server should not block other activities waiting for TCP
     data.
requirements.condition: While the server is waiting for TCP data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server should not block other activities while waiting for TCP data.
requirements.why_checkable: A stalled TCP sender can be used to check whether the server continues other work.

requirements.quote: - The server should support multiple connections.
requirements.condition: For a DNS server using TCP.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should support multiple connections.
requirements.why_checkable: Opening multiple TCP connections checks the recommended connection support.

requirements.quote:
- The server should assume that the client will initiate
     connection closing, and should delay closing its end of the
     connection until all outstanding client requests have been
     satisfied.
requirements.condition: When managing an established TCP connection.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should assume that the client will initiate connection closing.
requirements.why_checkable: The connection lifecycle policy can be inspected for its expected initiator and exercised after responses complete.

requirements.quote:
- The server should assume that the client will initiate
     connection closing, and should delay closing its end of the
     connection until all outstanding client requests have been
     satisfied.
requirements.condition: When a TCP connection has outstanding client requests.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should delay closing its end of the connection until all outstanding client requests have been satisfied.
requirements.why_checkable: Multiple pending requests can be exercised while observing whether server closure precedes their completion.

requirements.quote:
- If the server needs to close a dormant connection to reclaim
     resources, it should wait until the connection has been idle
     for a period on the order of two minutes.
requirements.condition: If the server needs to close a dormant TCP connection to reclaim resources.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should wait until the connection has been idle for a period on the order of two minutes before closing it.
requirements.why_checkable: The dormant-connection reclamation timer and observed idle duration can be checked against the approximate recommended interval.

requirements.quote:
- If the server needs to close a dormant connection to reclaim
     resources, it should wait until the connection has been idle
     for a period on the order of two minutes.  In particular, the
     server should allow the SOA and AXFR request sequence (which
     begins a refresh operation) to be made on a single connection.
requirements.condition: When managing dormant TCP connections, including resource reclamation.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should allow the SOA and AXFR request sequence that begins a refresh operation to be made on a single connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Issuing SOA followed by AXFR on one connection checks whether the recommended sequence remains possible.

requirements.quote:
- If the server needs to close a dormant connection to reclaim
     resources, it should wait until the connection has been idle
     for a period on the order of two minutes.  In particular, the
     server should allow the SOA and AXFR request sequence (which
     begins a refresh operation) to be made on a single connection.
     Since the server would be unable to answer queries anyway, a
     unilateral close or reset may be used instead of a graceful
     close.
requirements.condition: If the server needs to close a dormant TCP connection to reclaim resources and would be unable to answer queries anyway.
requirements.required_behavior: The server may use a unilateral close or reset instead of a graceful close.
requirements.why_checkable: The resource-reclamation closure path can be checked for the permitted unilateral close or reset behavior.
